messages:
jamie: Hey team — noticed a drop in prefetch KV cache hit-rate for prod-east ~2h ago. Where's the dashboard for prefix-level hit rates? Looks like tail latency spiked. Anyone own the alert?

sophia: Try Grafana -> Observability / KV Cache / Prefix hit-rate (we keep it under "Serving / KV Cache"). Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kvcache/prefix-hitrate

raj: Also check the per-prefix heatmap panel and the "prefetch miss ratio" panel. If you're in Datadog, metric is `redwood.kv.prefix_hit_ratio` and tag `prefix:<prefix>`.

jamie: thanks — do we have the PromQL for the global series? trying to add to my oncall playbook.

sophia: PromQL for 5m avg: 
```
avg_over_time(redwood_kv_prefix_hits_total[5m]) / avg_over_time(redwood_kv_prefix_requests_total[5m])
```
that gives per-prefix ratio if you group by prefix.

raj: FYI the current alert `KV_PREFIX_HITRATE_LOW` is firing at 78% global (threshold 80%). We probably need to avoid noisy flaps. Suggested: require >80% for 5m and >78% for 15m before paging.

li: who is the owner for that monitor? paging policy says Eng-Platform primary.

monitoring-bot: PagerDuty: eng-platform oncall (rotation: @li) — incident suppressed until threshold change.

li: I can take ownership for tuning. Proposal: change monitor to 3/5 minute evaluation with up-then-down annealing. I'll open a PR.

jamie: would like a dashboard link in the PR and the playbook note. Also can we add a panel with top-10 prefixes by miss rate + sample keys?

sophia: adding sample keys is tricky for PII — use hashed key sample. We have an existing panel template: `/dashboards/templates/kv-prefetch-top-miss-hash`

raj: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/monitoring/pulls/432 — description: "tune KV_PREFIX_HITRATE alert to reduce flapping, add top-10 missers panel (hashed keys)". Assigning to @li for review.

li: I'll review in ~30m. If urgent, ping me in DM. :thumbsup:

jamie: perfect. one follow-up — do we have historical baseline around the release yesterday? want to correlate with rollout.

sophia: yes — Grafana has `time shift` option. I pulled a comparison: pre-release 89% -> post-release 76% on some prefixes. Saving screenshot to #eng-platform-ops-assets.

raj: saving log query here for trace: `service=kv AND env=prod AND prefix=tx-* AND level=warn` — look for "cache_miss" events.

jamie: thanks all. Li, LMK when PR merged and I'll update the incident doc if needed.

li: will do. closing thread when done.
